error_content_security_policy.message: Content Security Policy (CSP) is missing: Highly recommended for improving security by mitigating cross-site scripting (XSS) and other content injection attacks.

info_content_security_policy.message: Content Security Policy is a computer security concept designed to prevent cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks.

error_x_frame_options.message: X-Frame-Options: Required for improving security by preventing clickjacking attacks and blocking the embedding of content in frames or iframes.

info_x_frame_options.message: The X-Frame-Options HTTP response header indicates whether a browser is allowed to render a page in a frame or iframe. Websites can use this header to prevent clickjacking attacks by ensuring their content cannot be embedded into other sites.

info_x_xss_protection_deprecated.message: X-XSS-Protection header detected. This header is obsolete — modern browsers ignore it or have dropped support in favour of Content-Security-Policy — so its presence or absence is informational only, not a security requirement.

error_x_content_type_options.message: X-Content-Type-Options: Required for improving security by preventing MIME sniffing attacks and enforcing the declared Content-Type.

info_x_content_type_options.message: Prevents MIME-sniffing for a specific HTTP response by enforcing the declared Content-Type, reducing the risk of content-type-based attacks.

error_referrer_policy.message: Referrer-Policy: Recommended for improving privacy by controlling the amount of referrer information sent with requests.

info_referrer_policy.message: Requests made from a document and navigations away from that document include a Referrer header. This policy determines whether the browser should send the referrer or not.

error_strict_transport_security.message: Strict-Transport-Security: Required for improving security by enforcing HTTPS, preventing HTTP connections, and mitigating man-in-the-middle (MITM) attacks.

info_strict_transport_security.message: The HTTP Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS) header instructs the browser to enforce HTTPS and reject HTTP connections.

info_x_ua_compatible.message: Allows a website to specify how a page is rendered in Internet Explorer 8, enabling it to enforce IE7 rendering mode instead of the default IE8 rendering.

info_alt_svc.message: HTTP/3 support detected via the Alt-Svc HTTP header.

info_x_robots_tag.message: X-Robots-Tag detected in the HTTP response headers.

warning_no_structured_data.message: No structured data (JSON-LD) was found on this page. Consider adding it to help search engines understand your content — eligible markup may also unlock rich results.

warning_no_meta_tags.message: No meta tags were found on this page. Adding meta tags can improve your site's SEO and visibility in search engines.

info_duplicate_meta_tag.message: The '%s' meta tag appears %s times on this page. Search engines and social crawlers may only use one of the values, so duplicates should usually be removed.

info_keyword_missing_in_title_secondary.message: Secondary focus keyword '%s' does not appear in the SEO title. Consider including it to strengthen relevance for that keyword.

info_keyword_not_in_title_first_half_sec.message: Secondary focus keyword '%s' appears in the SEO title, but not within its first half. Placing it earlier tends to carry more weight.

info_keyword_missing_in_description_prim.message: Primary focus keyword '%s' does not appear in the meta description. Consider including it to reinforce relevance in search snippets.

info_keyword_missing_in_description_seco.message: Secondary focus keyword '%s' does not appear in the meta description. Consider including it to reinforce relevance in search snippets.

info_keyword_missing_in_url_secondary.message: Secondary focus keyword '%s' does not appear in the URL. Including it can reinforce topical relevance, though it's not required.

info_keyword_not_in_content_start_primar.message: Primary focus keyword '%s' does not appear within the first 10%% of the page's main content. An early mention helps establish topical relevance quickly.

info_keyword_not_in_content_start_second.message: Secondary focus keyword '%s' does not appear within the first 10%% of the page's main content. An early mention helps establish topical relevance quickly.

info_keyword_missing_in_headings_primary.message: Primary focus keyword '%s' does not appear in any H2 or H3 heading. Including it in a subheading can help reinforce the page's topic.

info_keyword_missing_in_headings_seconda.message: Secondary focus keyword '%s' does not appear in any H2 or H3 heading. Including it in a subheading can help reinforce the page's topic.

info_keyword_density_low_primary.message: Primary focus keyword '%s' density is low at %s%%. Consider using it a little more naturally throughout the content.

info_keyword_density_low_secondary.message: Secondary focus keyword '%s' density is low at %s%%. Consider using it a little more naturally throughout the content.

warning_keyword_density_high_primary.message: Primary focus keyword '%s' density is %s%%, which reads as keyword stuffing. Reduce repetition and favour natural, varied phrasing.

warning_keyword_density_high_secondary.message: Secondary focus keyword '%s' density is %s%%, which reads as keyword stuffing. Reduce repetition and favour natural, varied phrasing.

info_keyword_density_elevated_primary.message: Primary focus keyword '%s' density is %s%%, above the recommended range. Keep an eye on it so the content still reads naturally.

info_keyword_density_elevated_secondary.message: Secondary focus keyword '%s' density is %s%%, above the recommended range. Keep an eye on it so the content still reads naturally.

error_empty_page_title.message: Page title is missing. Adding a clear, descriptive title helps improve SEO and enhances the page's visibility in search results.

info_short_page_title.message: Page title is %s characters, below the recommended minimum of %s. Longer, descriptive titles tend to perform better in search results.

info_long_page_title.message: Page title is %s characters, above the recommended maximum of %s. Search engines may truncate lengthy titles, reducing visibility and click-through rates.

warning_title_pixel_width.message: Page title renders at approximately %spx wide, above the recommended maximum of %spx, and may be visually truncated in search results. This is a display-width estimate, not Google's actual SERP rendering.

error_empty_meta_description.message: Meta description is missing. A well-crafted description can significantly enhance search visibility and user engagement.

info_short_meta_description.message: Meta description is %s characters, below the recommended minimum of %s. Detailed and relevant descriptions help clarify your content to users and search engines.

info_long_meta_description.message: Meta description is %s characters, above the recommended maximum of %s. Overly lengthy descriptions may be truncated in search results, leading to incomplete information being displayed.

warning_description_pixel_width.message: Meta description renders at approximately %spx wide, above the recommended maximum of %spx, and may be visually truncated in search results. This is a display-width estimate, not Google's actual SERP rendering.

error_empty_page_language.message: Page language is not specified. Declaring a language helps search engines and accessibility tools.

error_heading_h1_missing.message: Found %d heading(s) %s that should follow an H1, but H1 is missing.

error_heading_empty.message: Found %d empty heading(s): Empty headings hurt SEO by reducing content clarity and accessibility.

warning_missing_canonical_tag.message: Missing canonical tag: This can cause duplicate content issues and negatively impact SEO.

warning_multiple_canonical_tags.message: Found %s canonical tags on this page. Search engines may pick an unintended one when more than one is present — only a single canonical tag is recommended.

warning_malformed_canonical_tag.message: The canonical tag '%s' could not be resolved to a valid URL. Check that its href is a complete, well-formed URL.

warning_empty_canonical_tag.message: A canonical tag is present but its href attribute is empty, so search engines will ignore it.

info_canonical_has_fragment.message: Canonical URL '%s' includes a URL fragment (#...). Fragments are typically stripped by search engines, which can make the canonical resolve differently than intended.

info_canonical_cross_host.message: Canonical URL '%s' points to a different host than the current page. Cross-domain canonicals are valid but should be intentional.

info_canonical_points_elsewhere.message: Canonical URL points to '%s', a different URL than the current page. This is common for paginated, parameterized, or duplicate-content pages, but confirm it's intentional.

error_robots_txt_missing.message: The robots.txt file was not found, preventing search engines from receiving directives, which can negatively impact SEO.

error_blocked_robotstxt.message: The page %s is blocked by a robots meta tag, preventing search engines from indexing it. This can adversely affect SEO.

info_long_url.message: This URL is %s characters long, above the recommended maximum of %s. Shorter URLs tend to be easier to read, share, and fully display in search results.

help_checkbox_fetch_robotstxt.message: Disabling the fetching of robots.txt will prevent notifications about found sitemaps and skip checking whether internal links are blocked by robots.txt rules.

txt_headings_desc.message: Properly structured headings help with content organisation and improve SEO by signalling the importance of content to search engines. Missing or poorly structured headings can negatively impact accessibility and search ranking.

txt_images_desc.message: Optimising images, including using alt text, improves accessibility and SEO. Missing alt text or large image sizes can lead to poor search engine visibility and slow page loading.

txt_links_desc.message: Internal links enhance site navigation and distribute link equity, while external links increase site authority. Broken or excessive links can hinder user experience and SEO performance.

txt_structured_data_desc.message: Structured data (JSON-LD) helps search engines understand your content and can unlock rich results, such as ratings, prices, or availability, in search listings. Missing or invalid structured data means those opportunities are unavailable, though it does not affect basic indexing.

txt_meta_desc.message: Meta tags, such as titles and descriptions, play a crucial role in search ranking and click-through rates. Missing or duplicate meta tags can hurt search engine visibility and confuse users.
